title: Zero-touch Private Network Quick-Connect asset set
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create a compact, zero-touch Quick-Connect visual set and screenshot assets for Private/VPC onboarding that can be used in the Console quickstart, docs, and release notes. This ticket focuses on a CLI-first onboarding flow with progressive visual fallbacks: minimal tile for self-serve, an operator manifest preview for on-prem installers, a one-shot connectivity test animation, and an upgrade diff UI to show safe rolling upgrades. Deliverables should be optimized for reuse across docs, product banners, and localized translations.
acceptance_criteria: Figma master file with named frames: quick-connect-tile, cli-walkthrough, manifest-preview, connectivity-animation, upgrade-diff, status-banner
Three PNG export sizes for each key frame (1280x720, 800x450, 480x270) and SVGs for icons
Assets linked in Console PR (https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/4123) and docs site (https://docs.redwood.ai/private/quick-connect) with captions
Design tokens documented for color/spacing accessible to Engineering and Docs teams
Accessibility review notes captured and sign-off from Security/Compliance
tasks: Design quick-connect tile (compact, expanded, hover states)
Create CLI-first step screenshots with copy overlays for first-time network setup
Illustrate operator manifest preview with highlighted editable fields
Animate a one-shot connectivity test (GIF + Lottie export) for docs
Design upgrade diff visual to show pre/post config and rollback CTA
Prepare export package and README for Engineers and Docs
Coordinate asset handoff and add to Console PR
design_decisions: CLI-first: most enterprise installs start with an operator; screenshots emphasize copy-paste manifest and single-command bootstrap
Progressive disclosure: compact tile for self-serve users expands into actionable steps for operators to reduce cognitive load
Connectivity animation kept to <4s and loops off by default; provides clear success/failure states and links to logs
Upgrade diff highlights config changes and surface a rollback CTA tied to rollout strategy (canary toggle visible)
notes_for_engineering: Provide a CSS-safe SVG export and one PNG sprite set for the Console team
Include separate layers for text/buttons so Console can localize easily
Lottie export must be under 250KB for docs page embedding
Provide a small JS snippet example for the one-shot connectivity test embedding
